recordingEvidence: The author describes recording a vocal growl into a microphone and processing it in Audacity. Published 2014-09-23.
representation: Full-duration public HQ MP3 preview; the original WAV requires a Freesound account and was not downloaded.
processing: Remove first 0.05 s; playback-rate pitch shift to 85%; resample 48 kHz mono; 38 Hz high-pass and 6 kHz low-pass; +3 dB around 140 Hz; 0.10 s fade-in, 1 s fade-out; loudness normalization -18 LUFS, -3 dBTP target. No generated voice or oscillator layer.
subjectiveAudition: Agent selection uses author provenance, duration, source suitability and measured signal data. Human subjective listening remains the final check.
